summary: Chiron Real Estate Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Investment Agreement for the private placement of up to 1,000,000 shares of 6.00% Series C Convertible Perpetual Preferred Stock at $100.00 per share, for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $100 million. The sale may occur in tranches, with an initial closing of at least $25 million by June 20, 2026, and subsequent draws until November 6, 2026. Proceeds are for general business and working capital, including potential acquisitions. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation event.
